relations.text: 肝炎・HIV診断の事業で協業(Ortho時代からの共同事業)
relations.text_en: Collaboration on its hepatitis and HIV diagnostics business (joint business from the Ortho era)

source.label: QuidelOrtho 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company has the Joint Business between Ortho and Grifols, under which Ortho and Grifols agreed to pursue a collaboration relating to Ortho's Hepatitis and HIV diagnostics business.

source.label: QuidelOrtho 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of our principal competitors include, among others, Abbott Laboratories, bioMérieux, Bio-Rad, Danaher, Diasorin, Hologic, Qiagen, Revvity, Roche, Siemens Healthineers, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waters Corporation (acquired BD Diagnostics division) and Wermerson Immuncor.
